Title: Users may see 1:1 Microsoft Teams calls drop or fail to start

User impact: Users may see 1:1 Microsoft Teams calls drop or fail to start.

Current status: We determined that a recent change to authentication components is resulting in this impact. We're in the process of developing appropriate remediation steps to fully address this impact and will provide a resolution timeline as soon as one becomes available.

Scope of impact: This event impacts users in the United States and Asia Pacific, and any user in that region may see 1:1 Microsoft Teams calls drop or fail to start. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 2:15 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent change to authentication components is resulting in this impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 7:30 PM UTC
